question: The marked price of a mobile phone is 12% more than its cost price. If a discount of 8% is given on the marked price, then the gain per cent is:
solution:
Given:

Marked price of a mobile phone = 12% of C.P + C.P = (1.12)C.P

Formula used:

Discount = M.P – S.P

Where, M.P = Marked price, S.P = Selling price

Discount % = (Discount/M.P) × 100

Gain% = {(S.P - C.P)/C.P} × 100

Calculation:

According to question, 

M.P. = 1.12 C.P.

By using the formula,

Discount = M.P. – S.P.

⇒S.P = M.P - Discount 

⇒S.P = M.P - (0.08)M.P = (0.92)M.P = (0.92)(1.12)C.P = (1.0304)C.P

Gain% = {(S.P - C.P)/C.P} × 100

⇒ ((1.0304)C.P-C.P)/(C.P)× 100

⇒ 0.0304 × 100

⇒ 3.04%

∴ The Gain percent is 3.04%
